verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own marketing says users can connect RingCentral to LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude, and its developer site points to first-party MCP servers. That suggests natural-language operation through an external LLM client, but the evidence names no tools, no supported operations and no native in-app command interface, and nothing hands-on confirms it works. The Agentic Voice AI and AI Receptionist items automate customer interactions, not user operation of the product, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented MCP tool list and operation coverage, a native natural-language command interface, setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
